title: docs(contributing): add a Human Minimum section and a pull request template
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9REjCZdpYneJCoh3iaxyQGn)_
Part of #26081

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`CONTRIBUTING.md` 新增「Human Minimum」一节(第一个 PR 最容易犯的 8 条规则，每条一句话加指向 AGENTS.md 原文的链接，`Clause-②` 与 `Metadata-protocol` 在用到处定义);新建 `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`,用同一份清单做勾选项，并给出正文骨架和两条声明行。
- 为什么改：执行 #26081 裁决 A 的第二个 PR(裁决 6417533492);人类贡献者进门第一页现在把他们直接送进 82 KB 无目录的 AGENTS.md,PR 时也没有任何清单。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档，不改任何规则、门禁或发布包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。模板里的两条声明行留的是占位值，未填时读作「无声明」,不会替作者默认填 `no`/`none`。
- 先看：`CONTRIBUTING.md` 的 Human Minimum 第 5 条(Clause-② 定义)→ `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` → `CONTRIBUTING.md` 其余三处指针改动。
- 两分钟验证：在本分支上点「New pull request」,正文应自动出现模板;或打开 CONTRIBUTING.md 的 Human Minimum,逐个点 AGENTS.md 链接，都应落到对应标题。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(本 PR 不碰任何受管面)。

## What changes

- `CONTRIBUTING.md` gains a **Human Minimum** section between *Making a Change* and *Where Things Live*: eight items, each one sentence naming the rule plus a link to the AGENTS.md heading that states it (Zod first; naming; no formatter; one issue / branch / PR and worktrees; changeset with the two declaration lines; regenerate `packages/spec` artifacts; generated and release-owned files; English artifacts). Item 5 defines `Clause-②` and `Metadata-protocol` where they are used, as the ruling asks. No rule text is copied from AGENTS.md; the section says AGENTS.md text is the rule.
- Three existing CONTRIBUTING.md spots now point at the section: the intro paragraph, *Making a Change* step 3, and step 5 (which named `Clause-②` without defining it). *Opening the Pull Request* points at the new template. The TOC lists the section.
- New `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: a `Fixes #` first line, What changes / Why / Verification headings, the two declaration lines with placeholder values, and the Human Minimum list as checkboxes linking back to CONTRIBUTING.md.

## Tests

Docs only: no package, test or gate script changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Template placeholders are not declarations.** Measured with `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`: an unfilled `Clause-②: yes | no` reads `malformed` and `Metadata-protocol: added | narrowed | semantic | none` reads `malformed`, which `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` treats as no declaration. A template default of `no` / `none` would have declared for the author, so the template does not ship one.
- **Template binds no closing keyword:** `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --body .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` reports no parser binds (3 consulted).
- **Anchors into AGENTS.md are not gated.** `check:doc-anchors` scans `content/`, `README.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md` only, and lychee runs with `include_fragments = "none"`, so the seven AGENTS.md anchors this section links were checked by hand with `github-slugger@2.0.0` (the workspace copy): all seven resolve, as do the ten in-file anchors. PR 1 of #26081 (AGENTS.md TOC and `docs/agents/`, Tier H, waiting on #26035) must keep these headings or update these links.
- **Not done here:** AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, `.github/workflows/**` and `ui/` are untouched. The North Star pointer in CONTRIBUTING.md (the card cites `CONTRIBUTING.md:69`; it is line 111 on `main` and 114 after this diff) belongs to #26073 and is unchanged. The cloud#3194 precedent was read through the ruling and brief comments on #26081 (this session cannot read the cloud repository).
- Not governed: neither path is in `GOVERNED_SURFACES` (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`) or CODEOWNERS.

## Verification

Head `891a9b7a`, base `origin/main` `6390fe52`.
